data.disagreement_analysis: The initial disagreement was caused by a tool error in the qwen model, which returned a truncated/malformed response, leading to an 'inconclusive' verdict. The deepseek model correctly evaluated all files and returned 'safe'. The openrouter model was advisory only and does not count toward the verdict.
coverage_issues: qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-2507 failed with a tool error (truncated/malformed response), providing no valid verdict signal.
learnings: Implement automatic retries or fallback mechanisms when a model returns a truncated or malformed response to prevent tool errors from causing inconclusive verdicts and triggering unnecessary escalations.
